name: cost-manager
description: Cost Manager RESTful Web Services - 4 microservices root workspace

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix logs-service && npm install --prefix users-service && npm install --prefix costs-service && npm install --prefix about-service && npm install
scripts.start:all: npx concurrently -n logs,users,costs,about -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run start:logs" "npm run start:users" "npm run start:costs" "npm run start:about"
